name: Hume Hellsing
original_name: ヒューム・ヘルシング
source:
Hyumu Hellsing is a butler of the Kuki Family.

He is ranked #0 amongst the butlers and maids of the Kuki Group since the power gap between him and the #2 is just way too great.

He is the personal butler of the [url=/c56314]Kuki Mikado[/url] and his wife [url=/c9892]Tsubone[/url]. Hyumu is also entrusted with the protection of the children of the Kuki Mikado and Tsubone - [url=/c3800]Ageha[/url], [url=/c8346]Hideo[/url] and [url=/c5322]Monshiro[/url] - after Monshiro, the weakest of the three when it comes to physical prowess, transferred to Kawakami Academy.

Hyumu was trained in all kinds of martial arts and he mastered all the skills that focused on kicking. He joined the Kuki group to complete his skill-set by mastering the "Kuki Fighting Art".

The other servants call him Mr. Hyumu.

[Edited from [url=http://majikoi.wikia.com/wiki/Hyumu_Hellsing]Majikoi Wiki[/url]]
